relationships.subject: Guizhi Fuling Wan
relationships.evidence_quote: Vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) expression was inhibited by GFW, Gestrinone, Visanne, GFW + Gestrinone and GFW + MPA.

relationships.subject: Guizhi Fuling Wan
relationships.evidence_quote: The expression of intercellular adhesion molecule 1 (ICAM-1) was inhibited by GFW, Gestrinone, MPA, Visanne, GFW + Gestrinone, GFW + MPA and GFW + Visanne.

relationships.subject: Guizhi Fuling Wan
relationships.evidence_quote: Endometriosis development was inhibited by GFW, Gestrinone, Visanne, GFW + Gestrinone or GFW + medroxyprogesterone acetate (MPA).

key_findings: GFW inhibited endometriosis development and reduced VEGF and ICAM-1 expression in mice.
Combining GFW with hormonal therapies attenuated the VEGF/ICAM-1-reducing effects of GFW.
